title: Application of Nantucket Electric Company (1) under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375 and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 193B, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly fuel charge to be billing months of February, March, and April 1989. The fuel charge reflects changes in prudentely incurred, reasonable cost of fuel and power puchased by the Company, and (2) for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utilities Regulatory Policies Act of 1989.
